description:
Title: OEE

Write a process, that collects relevant information from a machine, and calculated the Overall Equipment Efficiency (OEE).
If the OEE falls below a certain value/percentage, stop the machine and send an email to an engineer.
When the machine is restarted, continue measuring.
When the machine is disconnected, stop the process.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_OEE" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/oee">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_MachineRestarted" name="Machine restarted"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_MachineDisconnected" name="Machine disconnected"/>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_OEE" name="OEE" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_OEE" name="Start OEE measurement">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Collect</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_MachineRestarted" name="Machine restarted">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Restart_Collect</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_MachineRestarted" messageRef="Msg_MachineRestarted"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CollectMachineData" name="Collect machine data">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Collect</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Restart_Collect</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Continue_No</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Collect_Calculate</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="BoundaryEvent_MachineDisconnected" name="Machine disconnected" attachedToRef="Task_CollectMachineData" cancelActivity="true">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Disconnected_Stop</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_MachineDisconnected" messageRef="Msg_MachineDisconnected"/>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CalculateOEE" name="Calculate OEE">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Collect_Calculate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Calculate_Gateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OEEThreshold_Split" name="OEE below threshold?" default="Flow_Continue_No">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Calculate_Gateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Below_Yes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Continue_No</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_StopMachine" name="Stop machine">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Below_Yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Stop_Email</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendEmailEngineer" name="Send email to engineer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Stop_Email</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Email_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_MachineHalted" name="Machine halted, engineer notified">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Email_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ProcessStopped" name="Process stopped">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Disconnected_Stop</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Collect" sourceRef="StartEvent_OEE" targetRef="Task_CollectMachineData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Restart_Collect" sourceRef="StartEvent_MachineRestarted" targetRef="Task_CollectMachineData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Collect_Calculate" sourceRef="Task_CollectMachineData" targetRef="Task_CalculateOEE"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Calculate_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_CalculateOEE" targetRef="Gateway_OEEThreshold_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Below_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_OEEThreshold_Split" targetRef="Task_StopMachine"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Continue_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_OEEThreshold_Split" targetRef="Task_CollectMachineData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Stop_Email" sourceRef="Task_StopMachine" targetRef="Task_SendEmailEngineer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Email_End" sourceRef="Task_SendEmailEngineer" targetRef="EndEvent_MachineHalted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disconnected_Stop" sourceRef="BoundaryEvent_MachineDisconnected" targetRef="EndEvent_ProcessStopped"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
